description: This file contains the implementation of the CategorizeEndpoints function and related helper functions for processing Kubernetes service endpoints based on topology and traffic policies.

methods.name: CategorizeEndpoints
methods.description: Classifies endpoints into cluster, local, and all reachable categories based on topology and traffic policies.

methods.name: topologyModeFromHints
methods.description: Determines topology mode ('', 'PreferSameZone', 'PreferSameNode') based on endpoint hints.

methods.name: availableForTopology
methods.description: Checks if an endpoint is available for use on the current node given a topology mode.

methods.name: filterEndpoints
methods.description: Filters a list of endpoints based on a predicate function.
